updater.title: Updates
updater.downloading: Version {version} is available and is being downloaded. You will be asked to restart once it is ready.
updater.readyDetail: Restart now to update, or later: the update is then installed when you quit the program. A running test server is stopped first.

share.chooseJoinFolder: Choose the folder with the shared project
share.chooseShareFolder: Choose a folder to share in (e.g. in OneDrive)

testServer.experimentalBuild: Note: Paper {version} only has an experimental build (#{build}).
testServer.javaNotFound: Java {version} was not found – downloading Eclipse Temurin {version} …
testServer.pluginJarMissing: The {plugin} JAR is missing. Please choose it again.
testServer.packTimeout: {plugin} did not report back – the resource pack is considered done.
testServer.reloadQueued: {plugin} is building the resource pack – it will be reloaded once that is done.
testServer.packReloading: {plugin} is reloading and building the resource pack …
testServer.packBuildingOnStart: {plugin} is building the resource pack on startup …
testServer.portInUse: Port {port} is already in use by another program – choose a different Minecraft port in the test server settings.
testServer.startingPaper: Starting Paper {version} with Java {java} ({ram} GB RAM) …
testServer.startFailed: The server could not be started: {error}
testServer.crashed: The server stopped unexpectedly (code {code}). See the console for details.
testServer.orphanStopped: A test server left running by an earlier session (process {pid}) was stopped.
testServer.notResponding: Server is not responding – killing it.
testServer.syncedSettings: Project transferred: {written} written, {deleted} removed, settings adjusted.
testServer.legacyMoveFailed: The server folder of an older version could not be moved: {error}
testServer.settingsReset: The saved test server settings were damaged and have been reset (kept as {file}).
testServer.manifestReset: The list of transferred files was damaged (kept as {file}); files from earlier transfers may remain in {folder}.
testServer.worldUnreadable: The server could not load its world. Use “Reset world” and start again.
testServer.crashReport: The server crashed and wrote a crash report (see the console).
testServer.incompleteWorld: The world of an earlier start that failed was incomplete; it was moved to {folder} and is created anew.
testServer.worldReset: The world was deleted; a new one is created on the next start.
testServer.bundledPacksRestored: Added {plugin}'s built-in packs that were missing on the server: {packs}
